--## v1.136 sync
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS table_action ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, table_name text NOT NULL, table_cond text NOT NULL, date_ text default (strftime('%Y-%m-%d','now')), ref_no text NOT NULL, action_ text NOT NULL, batch_ integer default 0, dev_id text, status integer default 0, param1 text,param2 text ,init integer default 0
);
--2024-11 allow bill_no dup from diff devices
drop INDEX if EXISTS uq_bills_no2 ;
--2025-12 allow bill_no dup from diff devices
drop INDEX if EXISTS uq_bills_no3 ;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX if not EXISTS uq_bills_no4 ON bills (tr_type,is_back,br_id,bill_no2,adj_id, CASE WHEN instr(online_ref2, ':') > 0 THEN substr(online_ref2, instr(online_ref2, ':') + 1,14) ELSE online_ref2 END ); -- if first closing CREATE UNIQUE INDEX if not exists transactions_ref2_uq ON transactions(online_ref2); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX if not exists transactions_h_ref2_uq ON transactions_h(online_ref2,date_); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX if not exists bills_h_ref2_uq ON bills_h(online_ref2,date_); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX if not exists bills2_h_ref2_uq ON bills2_h(online_ref2); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX if not exists items_h_ref2_uq2 ON items_h(online_ref2,name,date_);
drop TRIGGER if exists items_sync_insert
CREATE TRIGGER items_sync_insert after insert ON items when (NEW.online_ref2 is null) BEGIN update items set online_ref2=NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) where id=NEW.id; --for duplicated names with o_qty insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) select 'items','update items set o_qty=o_qty+'||NEW.o_qty||',o_cost='||NEW.o_cost ||',param1=online_ref2,online_ref2=null ' ||' where online_ref2=(select id from items where name='''||NEW.name||''''||')||'':''|| (select value_ from sys_conf where id=100)' || ' and param1 is null and name='''||NEW.name||'''' ,NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) ,'query' where NEW.o_qty!=0 and NEW.o_cost!=0; insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('items','where online_ref2='''||NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100)||'''' ,NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) ,'insert'); --for duplicated names with o_qty reset ref2 insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) select 'items','update items set online_ref2='|| ''''||NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100)||'''' ||' where online_ref2 is null and name='''||NEW.name||'''' ,NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) ,'query' where NEW.o_qty!=0 and NEW.o_cost!=0;
END
drop TRIGGER if exists items_sync_update
CREATE TRIGGER items_sync_update after update ON items when (NEW.online_ref2 is not null and OLD.online_ref2 is not null) BEGIN insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('items','where (param1 is not null and param1='''||NEW.online_ref2||''') or online_ref2='''||NEW.online_ref2||'''' ,NEW.online_ref2 ,'update'); END

CREATE TRIGGER transactions_sync_insert after insert ON transactions when (NEW.online_ref2 is null and NEW.online_ref=0 and NEW.bill_id in(0,-1,-2,-3,-6) ) BEGIN update transactions set online_ref2=(NEW.id)||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) where id=NEW.id; insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('transactions','where online_ref2='''||NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100)||'''' ,(NEW.id)||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) ,'insert'); END

CREATE TRIGGER users_sync_insert after insert ON users when (NEW.online_ref2 is null) BEGIN insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('users','where online_ref2='''||NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100)||'''' ,NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) ,'insert'); update users set online_ref2=NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) where id=NEW.id; --relogin insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('online_relogin','1' ,NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) ,'pref'); END
drop TRIGGER if exists users_sync_update
CREATE TRIGGER users_sync_update after update ON users when (NEW.online_ref2 is not null and OLD.online_ref2 is not null ) BEGIN insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('users','where online_ref2='''||NEW.online_ref2||'''' ,NEW.online_ref2 ,'update'); --relogin insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('online_relogin','1' ,NEW.online_ref2 ,'pref'); END
drop TRIGGER if exists users_sync_update0
CREATE TRIGGER users_sync_update0 after update ON users when (NEW.online_ref2 is null and NEW.id=0 and NEW.is_active=1 ) BEGIN update users set online_ref2=NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) where id=NEW.id; insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('users','where id=0' ,NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) ,'update'); END
--user_priv--only update --with first update drop TRIGGER if exists user_priv_sync_update_b
CREATE TRIGGER user_priv_sync_update_b after update ON user_priv when (NEW.online_ref2 is null ) BEGIN update user_priv set online_ref2=NEW.id||':'||(select value_ from sys_conf where id=100) where id=NEW.id; END
--without old ref2 drop TRIGGER if exists user_priv_sync_update
CREATE TRIGGER user_priv_sync_update after update ON user_priv when (NEW.online_ref2 is not null and OLD.online_ref2 is not null ) BEGIN insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values ('user_priv','where screen_id='''||NEW.screen_id||'''' ||' and user_id=(select c.id from users c where c.name=' ||''''||((select b.name from users b where b.id=NEW.user_id))||''''||')' ,NEW.online_ref2 ,'update'); --relogin --insert into table_action(table_name,table_cond,ref_no,action_) values -- ('online_relogin','1' -- ,NEW.online_ref2 -- ,'pref'); END
